name: @wavespeed/mcp

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Search the live WaveSpeed model catalog (image, video, audio, 3D). Returns model IDs usable with run_model. Do not invent model IDs — always pick one returned by this tool.

type.description: Filter by modality type, e.g. text-to-image, image-to-video

tools.name: get_model_schema
tools.description: Get a model's real input schema (required fields, properties, defaults). Call this before run_model so inputs match what the model actually accepts.

model.description: Model ID from list_models, e.g. bytedance/seedream-v5.0-pro

tools.name: run_model
tools.description: Run any WaveSpeed model. input keys come from get_model_schema; unknown keys are rejected before submission. Local files: pass "@./path" in a media field (image, images, video, audio, mask …) — it is uploaded and replaced with hosted URLs (bare paths are NOT uploaded). Returns the prediction id right away (done=false); call get_prediction with that id and wait_seconds until done=true to get the output URLs. The task keeps running on the server. Pass wait_seconds here to wait for a quick model in the same call.

wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the result in this call (default 0: return the prediction id right away)

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Create an image from a text description with the same models as the WaveSpeed /chat page (seedream-5-pro, nano-banana-2.1, nano-banana-2, nano-banana-pro, gpt-image-2.5, gpt-image-2; default seedream-5-pro). Give reference_images to use existing images as subject, product, face or style (the model's edit endpoint is used). To change existing images use edit_image. In the prompt, name input media as @image 1, @image 2, @video 1, @audio 1 (counted in the order the lists are given); they are renamed to what the model expects.

prompt.description: Complete visual prompt: subject, composition, style, lighting, mood.

model.description: Only when the user names a model; default is the first (Seedream 5 Pro).

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9, 9:21. The closest ratio the model supports is used; a note says when. If omitted: text-to-image is 1:1; with input images it is determined automatically from the input image.

resolution.description: Only when the user asks for a size. The closest size the model supports is used (a tie goes to the smaller one); a note says when.

wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the result in this call (default 0: return the prediction id right away)

estimate_only.description: true: only return the price estimate and the request that would run. Nothing is submitted or charged.

reference_images.description: Optional images whose subject, product, face or style the new image should use: public URLs, or "@./path" for local files (uploaded automatically).

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Change existing images with the same models as the WaveSpeed /chat page: edits, restyles, backgrounds, adding or removing things, combining several images. In the prompt, name input media as @image 1, @image 2, @video 1, @audio 1 (counted in the order the lists are given); they are renamed to what the model expects.

prompt.description: Complete visual prompt: subject, composition, style, lighting, mood.

model.description: Only when the user names a model; default is the first (Seedream 5 Pro).

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9, 9:21. The closest ratio the model supports is used; a note says when. If omitted: text-to-image is 1:1; with input images it is determined automatically from the input image.

resolution.description: Only when the user asks for a size. The closest size the model supports is used (a tie goes to the smaller one); a note says when.

wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the result in this call (default 0: return the prediction id right away)

estimate_only.description: true: only return the price estimate and the request that would run. Nothing is submitted or charged.

images.description: The images to edit, in order: public URLs, or "@./path" for local files (uploaded automatically).

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Create a video with the same models as the WaveSpeed /chat page (default seedance-2.5). Give first_frame to animate an image; give reference_images / reference_videos / reference_audios to keep characters, products, motion, voice or music. The right mode (text, image or reference to video) is picked from what you give. Videos can cost dollars: use estimate_only first when unsure. In the prompt, name input media as @image 1, @image 2, @video 1, @audio 1 (counted in the order the lists are given); they are renamed to what the model expects.

prompt.description: Shot description: subject, action, camera movement, style, sound.

model.description: Only when the user names a model (seedance-2.5, seedance-2.5-turbo, seedance-2.0, seedance-2.0-turbo, seedance-2.0-fast, seedance-2.0-fast-turbo, seedance-2.0-mini, wan-3.0, wan-3.0-prime, kling-4.0, minimax-h3). Without it the default (seedance-2.5) is used, and another model only when it cannot take the inputs.

first_frame.description: Image to start the video from (URL or "@./path").

last_frame.description: Optional image to end on (needs first_frame).

reference_images.description: Optional images for characters, products or style to keep (not a first frame): public URLs, or "@./path" for local files (uploaded automatically).

reference_videos.description: Optional videos for motion, camera or a character to follow: public URLs, or "@./path" for local files (uploaded automatically).

reference_audios.description: Optional audio for voice, music or sound to use: public URLs, or "@./path" for local files (uploaded automatically).

duration.description: Seconds, only when the user asks for a length; omit to use the model default. A length outside the model's range is moved into it; a note says when.

resolution.description: Only when the user asks for a resolution, or 480p for a cheaper draft; otherwise omit. The closest resolution the model supports is used (a tie goes to the lower one); a note says when. MiniMax H3 defaults to 768p (its equivalent of 720p).

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9, 9:21. The closest ratio the model supports is used; a note says when. If omitted, the model's default ratio is used; with first_frame the video follows that image's shape and this is ignored.

wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the result in this call (default 0: return the prediction id right away)

estimate_only.description: true: only return the price estimate and the request that would run. Nothing is submitted or charged.

reference_images.description: Optional images to use as references: public URLs, or "@./path" for local files (uploaded automatically).

reference_audios.description: Optional audio for voice, music or sound: public URLs, or "@./path" for local files (uploaded automatically).

tools.name: extend_video
tools.description: Continue an existing video with new footage after its end, with the same models as the WaveSpeed /chat page. Turbo models cannot extend. In the prompt, name input media as @image 1, @image 2, @video 1, @audio 1 (counted in the order the lists are given); they are renamed to what the model expects.

last_frame.description: Optional image the continuation should end on.

duration.description: Seconds of new footage; omit to use the model default. A length outside the model's range is moved into it; a note says when.

model.description: Only when the user names a model (seedance-2.5, seedance-2.5-turbo, seedance-2.0, seedance-2.0-turbo, seedance-2.0-fast, seedance-2.0-fast-turbo, seedance-2.0-mini, wan-3.0, wan-3.0-prime, kling-4.0, minimax-h3). Without it the default (seedance-2.5) is used, and another model only when it cannot take the inputs.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Estimate the cost of a run before executing it (no charge). Provide the same input you would pass to run_model — pricing often depends on inputs like duration or resolution, and a quote made without them can be lower than the real charge.

input.description: Inputs the quote should account for

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Show the WaveSpeed account credit balance, with the link to top up.

tools.name: list_predictions
tools.description: List past predictions (run history), newest window first. Defaults to the last 24 hours; pass since/until (ISO or YYYY-MM-DD) for other ranges. Use get_prediction with an id for one task in full.

since.description: Created after this time (ISO or YYYY-MM-DD)

until.description: Created before this time (ISO or YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: list_billings
tools.description: List itemized charges and refunds (billing records). Requires an API key with Billing access.

model.description: Filter by model ID as list_models returns it, e.g. bytedance/seedream-v5.0-pro

key.description: Filter by the API key uuid that generated the charge

since.description: Records after this time (ISO or YYYY-MM-DD)

until.description: Records before this time (ISO or YYYY-MM-DD)

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Usage statistics: spend, request counts, daily series and per-model breakdown. Defaults to the last 7 days. Requires an API key with Billing access.

since.description: Start (ISO or YYYY-MM-DD); default 7 days ago

model.description: Filter by model ID as list_models returns it, e.g. bytedance/seedream-v5.0-pro

tools.name: delete_predictions
tools.description: Delete finished predictions from this account's run history, up to 100 at a time. This is a soft delete: each record stays, with status "deleted" and without its outputs, and list_predictions and get_prediction still return it that way; the output links are revoked (best effort). This tool cannot undo it. Runs that are still going are left alone, and only the key's own organization's records are deleted. Ask the user first, and pass confirm: true only after they agreed to delete these ids.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user has agreed to delete these predictions

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a local file to WaveSpeed and get its hosted URL (identical bytes reuse the same upload for 24h). Usually unnecessary — run_model handles "@./path" inputs itself.

tools.name: get_prediction
tools.description: Fetch the status and outputs of a past or in-flight prediction by id — use to pick up a run that returned done=false. Pass wait_seconds to keep waiting for it to finish.

wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for a terminal status; 0 = return the current status now

instructions: WaveSpeed AI media generation (image, video, audio, 3D). Pattern: list_models to find a model, get_model_schema to see its inputs, run_model to execute. Reference local files as "@./path" values inside input — they upload automatically; bare paths are passed through untouched and will fail model validation. For plain image or video generation, generate_image, edit_image, generate_video, edit_video and extend_video pick the model and inputs for you (the models of the WaveSpeed chat page); pass estimate_only to get the price without running. Use get_price before expensive runs. Never invent model IDs or input keys. Long generations (video, some audio/3D) can run for hours: when run_model returns done=false, keep the id and poll get_prediction.
